results.title: Bhavana Mehta - Distributed Systems, Adaptive Databases, ML for ...
results.content: **🔍 On the Job Market!** Available for full-time positions starting 2025! # Bhavana Mehta Ph.D. Candidate · University of Pennsylvania Distributed Systems · Adaptive Databases · ML for Infrastructure ## News 🎉 Our paper **"Adaptive Sharding in Untrusted Environments"** has been accepted to **SIGMOD 2026**! My research focuses on distributed systems, scalable BFT consensus/SMR, adaptive sharding, workload-aware/runtime switching, machine learning for systems, and performance engineering. Please reach out at bhavanam@upenn.edu ## Research Interests My research interests span distributed systems, machine learning for systems, and high-performance computing: * **Adaptive Database Systems:** Designing self-tuning database architectures that dynamically adjust partitioning strategies, indexing, and replication in response to changing workloads and system conditions * **Quantitative System Optimization:** Applying mathematical modeling, reinforcement learning, and statistical methods to optimize distributed system performance and resource allocation * **Scalable Distributed Systems:** Creating highly available, fault-tolerant protocols with strong consistency guarantees for mission-critical applications * **ML for Systems Infrastructure:** Developing ML-powered techniques that automatically tune and optimize system configurations to maximize throughput and minimize latency ## Key Projects Adaptive sharded database tolerant to Byzantine faults. Technologies: BFT SMR, BFT-2PC, KaHyPar, Byzantine Fault Tolerance Contextual-bandit runtime that switches transaction paradigms per workload episode; improved committed throughput vs static baselines on skewed workloads while preserving correctness. Technologies: Multi-Armed Bandits, Transaction Processing, Blockchain, ML for Systems, Reinforcement Learning DPDK prototype to reassign active flows; measured ~4 μs migration on commodity servers; analyzed tail-latency and failure-recovery impact. Technologies: DPDK, TCP Migration, Performance Analysis Workload generators, client-side log metrics, one-click cluster bring-up, and CI sanity tests; produced reproducible figures and runbooks. Technologies: CI/CD, Monitoring, Infrastructure Automation ## Selected Publications * **Adaptive Sharding in Untrusted Environments** * **Towards Full Stack Adaptivity in Permissioned Blockchains** Chenyuan Wu, Mohammad J Amiri, Haoyun Qin, Bhavana Mehta, Ryan Marcus, Boon Thau Loo * **Towards Adaptive Fault‑Tolerant Sharded Databases** Bhavana Mehta, Neelesh C A, Prashanth Iyer, Mohammad J Amiri, Boon Thau Loo, Ryan Marcus * **AdaChain: A Learned Adaptive Blockchain** Chenyuan Wu, Bhavana Mehta, Mohammad J Amiri, Ryan Marcus, Boon Thau Loo ## Experience ### PhD Researcher Distributed Systems Lab, University of Pennsylvania * **Marlin:** Adaptive sharded database tolerant to Byzantine faults.

results.title: Top 10 Emerging Trends In Computer Science Engineering
results.content: Quantum computing promises to transform the landscape of problem-solving in fields such as drug discovery, materials science, and optimization, making it one of the most intriguing and promising trends in Computer Science Engineering for 2023. As AR and VR advance, they will revolutionize human-computer interaction, offer innovative solutions to multifaceted challenges, and solidify their status as pivotal trends in Computer Science Engineering for 2023. The impact of data science and big data analytics in transforming industries and enhancing decision-making processes solidifies their standing as core trends in Computer Science Engineering. The proliferation of these applications solidifies NLP and Conversational AI as pivotal trends in Computer Science Engineering for 2023. From the transformative potential of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to the game-changing impact of Edge Computing, the rise of blockchain technology, and the promise of Quantum Computing, these trends shape the future of our digital world. Data Science and Big Data Analytics enable data-driven decision-making, and Natural Language Processing and Conversational AI systems are redefining communication.
